title: 10 Epstein files conspiracy theories debunked
summary: Is Jeffrey Epstein alive in Israel? Is the real Ghislaine Maxwell in Canada, not jail? Were they somehow involved with the disappearance of Madeleine McCann and the death of JonBenet Ramsey? CBS News Confirmed investigated 10 of the most viral conspiracy theories to come out of the Epstein files. Here's what we found.
